mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_people AS currentPeople, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM volunteer WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_people AS currentPeople, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM volunteer WHERE volunteer_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer ( user_id, title, description, location, image_path, start_time, end_time, max_participants, status, current_people, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{imagePath}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxParticipants}, #{status}, #{currentPeople}, #{createdAt} )
